about: What a programmer needed to find while writing an XRender program in C from scratch, live, from documentation that answers little. Queries name only what was known at that point; expected identifiers are what the code that answered it calls.
source: Tsoding Daily, "X11 extension that changes everything (XRender)", https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=auzZCp45dJc
